summary_1line: Agastya recounts the lineage of Manu and Ikshvaku and the birth of Ikshvaku’s hundred sons, focusing on the flawed youngest, Danda, given his own kingdom.

image_candidates.scene_text: Manu places the crown on Ikshvaku and instructs him on righteous rule before departing for Brahma’s celestial abode.
King Ikshvaku stands among his hundred princely sons, while the youngest, Danda, appears foolish and ignored by the others.
Danda founds the mountain-ringed city of Madhumanta between the Vindhya and Shaivala ranges under the guidance of his guru Shukra.
